title: YOUR TEAMMATE'S SHIELD BUBBLE IS SEEN IN YOUR WINDOW
why: The SHIELD BUBBLE power-up (v26.89) is drawn only round your own player (pwrDraw2), and the state word sent to the teammate carried a shield flag only for the DEMO spawn shield, so neither window ever saw the bubble on the other, in DEMO or in a normal Undercroft raid. Damage was already right; only the look was missing. Proven in a staged pair in one window: with the bubble up player 2's state word had no bubble flag, the host kept none and drew nothing round him. Now the word carries pb while the bubble is up, the host keeps it and passes it on, and the teammate is drawn inside the same bubble (same colours, radius and centre) on the world canvas, without the flash and the end blink that only his own window knows.
now: In co-op, when your teammate picks up a SHIELD BUBBLE you now see the bubble round him too.

edits.anchor: if(G.arcade&&p.arcSh) msg.sh=1;   // v23.30 (arcade9): only while shielded
edits.replacement:

  if(pwrOn('shield')) msg.pb=1;   // v16.xx (cloud-coop-teammate-shield-bubble), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: pb, his SHIELD BUBBLE power-up is up, so his teammate sees the bubble too
